question.question: Does Delta snapshot consumption preserve the selected decided prefix when a legal synchronization advances the receiver decided index beyond the boundary used by the delta producer?
question.importance: Incorrect reconstructed snapshot could expose missing or duplicate decided application effects and propagate corrupted history across authority transitions.

question.trigger_rationale: sync_log updates cached decided index before create_decided_snapshot, while create_diff_snapshot starts at the earlier receiver boundary. This concrete boundary mismatch is more discriminating than transport-loss variants whose caller contract remains unclear; source guards do not establish that boundaries must coincide.

obligation.description: When synchronization replaces a decided log prefix with a snapshot, the resulting snapshot must represent that entire selected decided prefix, preserving previously decided entries as well as the incoming delta under the supplied Snapshot create/merge semantics.

scope.description: Snapshot-enabled synchronization between replicas in one configuration, with a lawful concatenating snapshot, successful MemoryStorage operations and implementation-produced messages following a temporary disconnection and reported reconnection.
assumptions: Unique configured node IDs and common configuration.
Snapshot::create summarizes its exact slice; merge appends the represented later history.
No Byzantine messages, storage errors, process crash or overlapping API calls.
excluded: Whole-application execution beyond public decided-log export
Other snapshot representations or optional runtime features

grounding.derivation: Snapshot documentation describes preserving data rather than discarding it, and SnapshotType defines Complete as all snapshotted data and Delta as changes since an earlier snapshot. Repository ValueSnapshot creates an exact entry vector and extends it on merge, establishing this non-idempotent representation as supported rather than an invented requirement. sync_log is the implementation owner that merges the incoming delta into the existing decided prefix before exporting a compacted snapshot.
grounding.applicability: Same-configuration recovery with an actual producer-generated AcceptSync and successful storage operations. No deadline or eventual-progress assertion.
alternatives: A Complete transfer replaces the whole snapshot and does not exercise delta-base construction.

associations.rationale: This is the concrete snapshot-installation owner for the preservation requirement.
